thuti.p: [Thu+ti] (thī) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 118. Nīti, dhā. 68, 249. Thu+i. Addhamāgadhī, dhāna.(stuti-saṃ)] (1) Praising, Blessing, (A) One who praises at present. (B) One who praises one's behind. (2) (Words or speech, Saddā etc.,) which is the cause of praising. (3) Thuti-saddā.(Ti) (4) One who praises for one's power and glory. See - Thutimāgadhavandikācariyaka.  (5) One who was praised by other persons. See - Thutippasattha.
